title.purpose: Section headers, card titles, leaderboard headers.

body.purpose: Default reading size — body copy, form values, table cells.

label.purpose: Small uppercase system labels — KPI labels, group headers, badge/tag text.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Resting cards, KPI tiles, the leaderboard card.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Elevated card variant, topbar dropdown, switch thumb.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and toasts — content interrupting the page flow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action — Signal Green capsule with a scale-press interaction.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: var(--text-base); font-weight: var(--weight-semibold); border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-brand); color: var(--white); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-brand-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-brand-active); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline capsule button for lower-emphasis actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--surface-page); color: var(--text-primary); border-color: var(--border-default); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--text-primary); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Tinted status pill — success/warning/danger/neutral tones for order and lead status.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: var(--weight-semibold); font-size: var(--text-xs); padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-badge-success { background: var(--color-brand-tint); color: #517f6e; } .ds-badge-warning { background: #faf1e2; color: var(--state-warning); } .ds-badge-danger { background: #f8e9e8; color: var(--state-danger); }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Removable content chip — quieter, sharper-radius sibling to the status badge.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: var(--text-sm); padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-subtle); color: var(--text-primary); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); } .ds-tag button { all: unset; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text-tertiary); line-height: 0; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default content container — hairline border plus ambient shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface-raised); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28,28,28,0.06); padding: 24px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: var(--weight-semibold); font-size: var(--text-base); color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 12px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Labeled text field with a soft green focus glow.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-field-label { font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-input { height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); background: var(--surface-page); color: var(--text-primary); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: var(--text-base); transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-brand); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-brand-tint-strong); }

components.name: Switch
components.description: Toggle with a physically sliding thumb — the system's most tactile control.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--text-primary); cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch input { display: none; } .ds-switch-track { width: 42px; height: 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink-200); position: relative; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-switch-track::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--white); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(28,28,28,0.08); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track { background: var(--color-brand); } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track::after { transform: translateX(18px); }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Underline tab bar for switching between sub-views within a page.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-tab { padding: 10px 4px; font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); color: var(--text-secondary); background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; margin-right: 20px; transition: color 120ms; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-tab-active { color: var(--color-brand); border-bottom-color: var(--color-brand); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Signature component: the dark rail's nav row, with its green active-state icon recolor.
components.css: .ds-sb-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 10px; color: #d9d9d9; text-decoration: none; font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: var(--weight-medium); transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); background: #1c1c1c; } .ds-sb-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-sb-item-active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #ffffff; } .ds-sb-icon { font-size: 12px; } .ds-sb-item-active .ds-sb-icon { color: var(--color-brand); }

components.css: .ds-tile { background: var(--surface-raised); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28,28,28,0.06); padding: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-tile-head { font-size: var(--text-xs); font-weight: var(--weight-semibold); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--text-secondary); } .ds-tile-value { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--text-xl); font-weight: var(--weight-bold); color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-tile-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-tile-caption { font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--text-secondary); } .ds-tile-delta { font-size: var(--text-xs); font-weight: var(--weight-semibold); } .ds-tile-delta-good { color: var(--state-success); }

narrative.overview:
Chadwell CRM reads as an operator's console, not a marketing surface: a fixed dark rail down the left edge holds the whole map of the business, and everything to its right is a calm, well-lit instrument panel for working through orders one at a time. The system is built for someone who is at this screen for hours a day, moving customers through a real pipeline (Consumer QC → Awaiting Contract → Fully Connected, and every stage between) — so it favors legibility and quiet consistency over expression. Signal Green is the one color that's allowed to mean something; everywhere else the palette recedes into near-black rail, white working surface, and a narrow band of warm grays.

The aesthetic philosophy is calm and professional: competent, unshowy, the opposite of the neon-gradient "AI startup dashboard" look. Nothing here is decorative for its own sake — a color, a shadow, or a radius is present because it's carrying information (status, hierarchy, interactivity), and the system explicitly avoids visual noise that would compete with the sales/ops data on screen.
keyCharacteristics: Dark instrument rail (near-black, --ink-900) fixed on the left, white working surface on the right — the console/canvas split repeats at every scale.
Signal Green is reserved for functional moments only: primary actions, active nav state, links, and positive/success signals.
Poppins carries anything scanned for orientation (titles, KPI numbers); Work Sans carries anything read (body copy, labels, table cells).
Interactive controls are fully rounded capsules; content containers use a softer 6–16px radius scale instead.
Shadows are ambient, not symbolic — a quiet lift under resting surfaces, deepening naturally for anything physically floating above the page.

rules.name: The Working Color Rule
rules.body: Signal Green only appears where it's doing something — a primary action, an active nav state, a live link, a completed/success status. It never appears as ambient decoration or a background fill outside those functional moments.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Poppins is reserved for anything a user scans for orientation — page titles, section headers, card titles, KPI numeric values. Work Sans carries everything actually read — body copy, form fields, labels, table cells.

rules.name: The Capsule Rule
rules.body: If it's clickable and small (a button, an icon button, a badge, a switch), it's a fully-rounded pill. If it contains other content (a card, an input, a dialog, a tag), it uses the softer 6–16px scale instead.

dos: Do keep Signal Green tied to function — primary actions, active state, links, positive/success signals — never as a decorative fill.
Do use the capsule (999px) radius exclusively for small interactive elements; use 6–16px radii for anything that contains content.
Do set Poppins on anything scanned for orientation and Work Sans on anything read.
Do pair a hairline border with an ambient shadow on cards — neither carries the surface alone.
Do give every interactive control a fast (120–200ms), no-bounce transition and a visible press/focus state.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue.
Don't mix the capsule and soft-radius languages on the same element class.
Don't reach for heavier shadows to signal importance.
Don't add gradients, glows, or decorative color washes outside the established tint steps.
